info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Data Switch Configuration API
info.description: The Market Data Switch Configuration API facilitates the dynamic management and configuration of market data switch settings. Using this API endpoint, consumers can update specific parameters related to their market data management operations, ensuring optimal data flow and switch functionality. Typical use cases include financial institutions and trading platforms that require real-time adjustments to market data settings based on changing operational requirements. The API enables seamless integration of new configurations with minimal disruption to ongoing services.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the settings and parameters associated with the market data switch for a specific resource. Ensure to provide the necessary fields in the request body for a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific attributes of the market data switch identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON payload adheres to the defined schema for the successful modification of the market data switch settings.
